_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: baseline rates

agreement.claim: both engines report the same centre lines, limits and signals
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0, qcc against the written-out charts. harness/trials_examples.test.py rebuilds the u-chart limit and shows the u-chart's first signal comes at or after the rise in over 80% of seeds while the steady p- and individuals charts average under 0.5 signals.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Baseline centre lines from 12 months each. Measured by harness/trials_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic (owner decisions E5, E6).
